events.message: Language host operation failed at {stage}

server.description: Core-resolved language server identity owning this host operation

stage.description: Host operation step that failed, such as entrypoint-warmup or language-import

error.description: Native or stable runtime error that caused the host operation fallback

events.message: Language server log message received for server {server} with severity {severity}

server.description: Validated language server session id that sent window/logMessage

diagnostic.description: Original message from the window/logMessage params, redacted and capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes
diagnostic.reason: The language server owns the unstructured window/logMessage explanation and exposes no stable error code for it, so preserve its original wording after redaction and truncation.

severity.description: LSP MessageType mapped to a controlled severity word, e.g. error, warn, info or log

events.message: Language server show message received for server {server} with severity {severity}

server.description: Validated language server session id that sent window/showMessage

diagnostic.description: Original message from the window/showMessage params, redacted and capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes
diagnostic.reason: The language server owns the window/showMessage explanation shown to the user; retain its original wording after redaction and truncation to correlate a reported message with the server session.

severity.description: LSP MessageType mapped to a controlled severity word, e.g. error, warn, info or log

events.message: Language server {server} notification {method} received

server.description: Validated language server session id that emitted the notification

method.description: LSP notification method name, e.g. language/status; never the notification payload

events.message: Language service process started for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id whose process started

runtime_version.description: Runtime version reported for the language server launch, when available

events.message: Language service protocol initialized for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id whose initialize handshake completed

events.message: Late language-server response ignored for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id that received an obsolete response

request.description: JSON-RPC response id of the late reply; absent when the response has no id

events.message: Language server shutdown timed out for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id whose shutdown deadline expired before termination

events.message: Language server stderr read failed for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id whose stderr pipe could not be read

error.description: I/O error returned by the language server stderr reader

events.message: Language server stderr received for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id that wrote the stderr diagnostic

diagnostic.description: Unclassified upstream stderr diagnostic; retained only for detailed diagnosis and never treated as an operation failure
diagnostic.reason: Language servers emit implementation-specific failure explanations only on stderr, so retain the original diagnostic wording for diagnosis after redaction and truncation rather than attempting an unstable parser.

truncated.description: Whether the upstream stderr line exceeded the 4096 byte reader limit

events.message: Language server trace received for server {server}

server.description: Validated language server session id that sent $/logTrace

diagnostic.description: Upstream trace summary only, redacted and capped at 1024 UTF-8 bytes; verbose RPC payloads are excluded
diagnostic.reason: Upstream trace messages describe internal protocol decisions without structured equivalents; retain their wording only during explicitly enabled detailed diagnostics.

events.message: Language server session state changed

server.description: Language provider identity from the registered host provider catalog.

state.description: Core session lifecycle state emitted by the managed engine (for example ready or stopped).

events.message: Language server {server} operation failed

server.description: Language provider identity owned by the registered session.

stage.description: Actual source stage, such as discovery, configuration, documentSync or processStart.

failure_code.description: Stable failure classification supplied by the owning runtime or host boundary.

exit_code.description: Native language server process exit status when supplied by the runtime.

events.message: Language server {server} operation degraded

server.description: Language provider identity owned by the registered session.

stage.description: Actual source stage, such as discovery, configuration, documentSync or processStart.

failure_code.description: Stable failure classification supplied by the owning runtime or host boundary.

exit_code.description: Native language server process exit status when supplied by the runtime.

events.message: Language server {server} host stage changed to {stage}

server.description: Core-resolved language provider routing segment shared with engine session events.

stage.description: Closed host orchestration stage: requested, resolving, registered, stopping, or cancelled.

events.message: Language server {server} cache cleaned

server.description: Core-resolved language provider routing segment whose workspace cache was pruned.

removed.description: Number of workspace cache entries removed by the host cache cleaner.

events.message: Engine process cleanup failed

server.description: Validated session identity selected from the explicit engine role

error.description: Stable native cleanup failure category; excludes process arguments and paths
